logo.description: A faceted coffee bean, cut like an agate stone and split by a zig-zag crease. One flat color, no outlines or gradients, in the same spirit as the Elaenia bird.
rules: Use olive on light backgrounds and cream on olive or dark backgrounds.
Keep the original proportions and the transparent background; do not add a backing shape.
Leave clear space around the bean of at least one quarter of its width.
The illustrated agate bean and the script wordmark remain the packaging artwork; the flat bean is for interfaces, favicons and small sizes.
